{{Top|leg}}
A '''voice-activated computer''' was a piece of [[Starship/Legends|starship]] hardware that could be acquired from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] of [[Mechis III/Legends|Mechis III]]. These [[Computer/Legends|computers]] would respond to verbal commands and requests and were unreliable at times. One of these computers was installed aboard the [[Mist Hunter/Legends|''Mist Hunter'']], the personal working vessel of [[Zuckuss/Legends|Zuckuss]], a [[Gand/Legends|Gand]] [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]].<ref name="OPF">{{StoryCite|story=Of Possible Futures: The Tale of Zuckuss and 4-LOM|book=Tales of the Bounty Hunters}}</ref>
